visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a small, black iron skillet with a polished silver handle held by a person's hand. The background is a brightly lit, slightly blurred kitchen interior. Large blue and white text boxes with Traditional Chinese characters are overlaid on the center of the frame, accompanied by a small red heart icon. (2) The camera cuts to a wider view of a modern kitchen wall. Various stainless steel cooking utensils, including a ladle, spatula, and a small black pan, are hanging neatly from individual silver hooks mounted on a white backsplash. Above the backsplash are light-colored wooden cabinets. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a black induction cooktop. A hand places the small black iron pan onto the circular cooking zone. The surrounding countertop is clean and white, reflecting the bright studio-style lighting from above. A bottle of blue liquid is partially visible in the background. (4) The pan is then placed on a portable, off-white butane gas stove. A black circular metal stand is placed onto the burner by a hand to stabilize the small pan. The background remains the same bright kitchen environment with soft, natural daylight coming from the side. (5) The video shows the pan heating on the induction stove. A finger presses the touch-sensitive power and temperature controls on the cooktop's surface. The pan remains empty, and the lighting is even and bright, highlighting the smooth texture of the iron. (6) A small white ceramic bowl containing clear oil is held above the pan. A hand uses a silver tablespoon to pour the oil into the center of the skillet. The oil spreads across the black surface under the focused studio lighting. (7) The skillet is lifted by its handle and tilted in a circular motion to ensure the oil coats the entire inner surface and side walls. The movement is smooth and deliberate. The background shows a wooden cutting board and kitchen tiles. (8) A single white egg is cracked against the edge of a small white ceramic bowl. The egg yolk and white fall into the bowl. This action happens on a wooden surface in the bright kitchen. (9) The pan is tilted over the same white bowl to pour out the hot, shimmering oil. A few drops fall into the bowl. The pan's surface appears glossy and well-coated. (10) A hand uses a white paper towel to wipe the interior of the pan while it is still warm. The paper towel moves in a circular motion, removing excess oil and ensuring an even finish. The lighting emphasizes the sheen on the iron. (11) Fresh oil is poured from a white bottle with a green cap into a measuring spoon, then into the pan. The pan is placed back on the induction stove, and heat is applied until faint oil ripples appear on the surface. (12) The beaten egg is poured from the bowl into the hot pan. The egg immediately starts to cook, forming a thin yellow layer. A pair of dark chopsticks is used to gently lift and fold the egg, demonstrating the non-stick quality of the newly seasoned pan. (13) The cooked egg is folded and transferred onto a small, green flower-shaped plate. Red ketchup is drizzled in a zigzag pattern over the egg. The plate sits on a wooden board in the brightly lit kitchen. (14) The pan is taken to a stainless steel sink and washed under a stream of water from a black faucet. A yellow sponge is used with a small amount of soap to scrub the surface. The scene is bright and highlights the water droplets on the metal. (15) After drying with a pink towel, a small amount of clear oil is poured back into the pan. A paper towel is used to spread the oil evenly across the surface for storage, preventing rust. The final shot shows the pan looking clean and shiny.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 鐵鍋開鍋方式. [Variety]: 學會之後受用無窮❤️. [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 大家好，我是Tata. 今天來分享鐵鍋的開鍋方式. (2) [Subtitle]: 鐵鍋平常可以掛在掛勾上或者放在櫃子裡. (3) [Subtitle]: 琺瑯鑄鐵鍋 不鏽鋼鍋 鐵鍋操作方式都一樣. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個日本製的鐵鍋 對應感應爐非常快!. (5) [Subtitle]: 也可以用在瓦斯爐上. (6) [Subtitle]: 擔心加熱不均 可以買這種小鍋爐架. (7) [Subtitle]: 第一次使用！鍋子先在爐上 中火加熱兩分鐘. (8) [Subtitle]: 時間到，關火30秒. (9) [Subtitle]: 接著加入3大匙耐高溫的油. (10) [Subtitle]: 開中小火 加熱5~8分鐘. (11) [Subtitle]: 中途搖晃鍋子 讓周圍都沾到油脂. (12) [Subtitle]: 偶爾搖晃幾次 確保油膜的產生. (13) [Subtitle]: 開鍋方式 不需要每次都這麼做. (14) [Subtitle]: 等待開鍋的時候來打個蛋. (15) [Subtitle]: 等鍋子充分加熱後 倒掉開鍋的油. (16) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡殘留的油 用廚房紙巾抹乾淨. (17) [Subtitle]: 開鍋的油丟棄不要. (18) [Subtitle]: 現在倒入不到10cc的油. (19) [Subtitle]: 中小火加熱. (20) [Subtitle]: 直到鍋裡的油產生油紋. (21) [Subtitle]: 現在就可以加入蛋液測試. (22) [Subtitle]: 稍微等待一下 讓蛋液表面凝固. (23) [Subtitle]: 如果油膜有成功 煎蛋、煎豆腐、煎魚都不會沾喔. (24) [Subtitle]: 現在鐵鍋已經完全不沾囉！. (25) [Subtitle]: 學會之後 煎蛋、煎魚、煎豆腐都不會沾. (26) [Subtitle]: 新手我會建議買小的鍋子來練習. (27) [Subtitle]: 等你已經掌握到訣竅的時候 再買大尺寸的鍋子. (28) [Subtitle]: 這樣才不會一開始挫折感很大. (29) [Subtitle]: 不是火越大越不沾！. (30) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋跟鐵鍋的好處就是可以用一輩子. (31) [Subtitle]: 控制火侯不要太大 油煙就不會大. (32) [Subtitle]: 你只要花一次錢 就可以用很久很久. (33) [Subtitle]: 小鍋子超適合煎蛋 做早餐、煮湯麵也很適合. (34) [Subtitle]: 清潔部分. (35) [Subtitle]: 沖洗乾淨 一點點的洗碗精沒關係. (36) [Subtitle]: 沒有洗乾淨 我覺得鍋子很噁心. (37) [Subtitle]: 最後用90度熱水 沖洗鍋子. (38) [Subtitle]: 擦乾. (39) [Subtitle]: 淋一點油 抹均勻. (40) [Subtitle]: 像這樣鍋子 就不會生鏽啦. (41) [Subtitle]: 鐵鍋永遠亮晶晶的樣子. (42) [Logo]: IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a comprehensive, step-by-step instructional guide on how to season and maintain a new iron pan to ensure it achieves non-stick properties and remains rust-free. The video uses a successful egg-frying test to prove the effectiveness of the method, appealing to home cooks and kitchenware enthusiasts.
